title: Grayton Grateful | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Grayton Grateful is a 3.00 bedroom, 3.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Wide open living spaces with beautiful designer touches welcome you as you walk into Grayton Grateful. The large kitchen island is the hub of the home where you are sure to all gather and spend time as a family. Enjoy the chef's kitchen and stunning entertaining space. There's a first floor master suite as well as a one-of-a-kind screened-in porch with TV and gas fireplace. Head out back to BBQ on the gas grill, or try your hand with the smoker as well. There's a half bath on this level as well for guests.The 2nd floor includes the other 2 bedrooms, both with private bathrooms and large closets. Plus, there's a set of bunk beds on the landing. The 3rd level of the home features fun gathering space plus a convenient half bath and kitchenette with beverage fridge. There is also a twin sleeper in the oversized chair on this level. Walk onto the balcony and grab some Gulf views and watch an amazing 30A sunset.All TVs in the home have Roku sticks, so you'll never be without entertainment options. Each bedroom also includes a TV.Sleeping Arrangements:1st Floor, Bedroom 1: King master suite with private bathroom2nd Floor, Bedroom 2: King bed, balcony access and private bathroom2nd Floor, Bedroom 3: 2 full beds, balcony access and private bathroom.2nd Floor Landing: Built-in twin-over-twin bunksThere is a twin sleeper chair on the 3rd floor along with a convenient half bath.Beach Access:Head east down Barton's Way, making a right onto Morgan's Trail. Directly across 30A past Sanctuary by the Sea, is your gated boardwalk access. Once down the pathway, head right towards the public beach or on your left past the sections of private beach you'll find Grayton Beach State Park.Distance: 0.5 miles | Time: 10 minutes walkingPreserve at Grayton Beach:The Preserve at Grayton Beach is an ultra-exclusive and gated community right on Scenic 30A. This neighborhood features custom built beach-chic homes with state-of-the-art amenities and inclusions. In one of these meticulously appointed homes, you’ll find yourself surrounded by one-of-a-kind beauty that is unsurpassed in every sense. Enjoy 2 community pools (1 heated seasonally) and tennis courts. The location puts you within walking or biking distance from all the area's popular spots. From ice cream to shopping, you'll find it in the Grayton Beach and Blue Mountain Beach areas.30A:30A is a scenic stretch of highway down Florida’s beautiful Gulf Coast between Destin and Panama City Beach. The highway connects the coastal villages of South Walton through the undisturbed beauty of rare dune lakes, sugar white sand, and emerald waters indigenous to the area. Each village has its own unique characteristics that paint a fairytale-like scene against some of the country’s most beautiful beaches. Come live the 30A life and experience the beach the way it was meant to be, where Southern Charm meets Bohemian Lifestyle and unforgettable vacation memories are created.Your stay at Grayton Grateful comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Sorry, no pets allowed.* Parking for 3 cars.* No golf carts or trailers allowed in the Preserve at GraytonAn initial Benchmark signature box of amenities is provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, 1 pack of kitchen wipes and liners for each trashcan plus 2 washing machine pods. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of facial and bath soaps/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom.
